title: What the ClipNote search investigation established, and what it did not
question: After static analysis of the ClipNote search path, which questions are actually settled, and which remain open?

environment: No analysis engine configured: Hopper is unsupported on this host and neither Ghidra nor IDA was set, so every record here is static analysis or registry bookkeeping.

commands.purpose: Record an unresolved question in REA so it cannot be silently dropped from the investigation

commands.command: update_unknown { status: resolved, resolution: { disposition: out-of-scope } }
commands.purpose: Close a question as out of scope, with a rationale and a new revision

findings.statement: REA retained three residual unknowns for this investigation: two remain open and one was closed as out of scope, and the bundle keeps the full revision history of each.
limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Registry mutation evidence records analyst intent, not proof of the answer.

findings.statement: Both remaining open questions require controlled-replay authority, and no record in this bundle carries it, so no amount of further static analysis on this host can close them.
limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
